changeLog: New in this version: the gold buttons DMB adds, in the game and the launcher, use the lobby BEGIN button's own gold with its fine grain; each computer seat is named after the computer player that plays it; the seat row's button reads "Starting Resources" and fits its box. With OmniMapGen 0.3.37: almost every slider has a Template position and Reset puts them back on it; a control that does nothing on the layout you chose is greyed, and its right-click text says what it will do once built; "Subterranean Like Overworld" makes the underground a second map like the overworld; Special buildings from the original maps are Template, Random, Off or On, with a slider for how many. Everyone who plays together should update.
